![Description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62a6acb3bac106a194a4cba46b32b068c6cf5a57.png)

Этот пакет перерисовывает железного голема, а также добавляет новую вариацию.

- Любой естественныйゴーлем будет Covered in poppies.
- Qualquer golem creado pelo jogador agora terá uma aparência completamente nova, com ferro brilhante e sem vinhos ou flores crescendo sobre ele.

---

![Info](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66305c7c9ba1a3e0c32d723c4d8ff389fc5a191.png)

Requer [_Entity Model Features_](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitymodelfeatures) e [_Fresh Animations_](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) versão 1.10.0 ou superior.
